examples.quote: The specified interventions did not consistently remove the population pattern. In the primary 48-founder comparisons, halving eligible reproductive opportunities for parents under 50 or aged 150 and older generally produced uncertain changes in the food-dependent threshold effect. One estimate for older parents with staggered founder ages suggested a change in the opposite direction to removal of the pattern, but its interpretation is sensitive to multiple comparisons. These results do not establish that age-specific reproduction has no causal role: realized birth reductions were much smaller than the 50% opportunity blocks.
